coverage_assessment: Seventeen one-query web searches covered four January week windows, general English terms, French and Kinyarwanda terms, local outlets (Kigali Today, IGIHE, The New Times), official and retrospective sources, and December/February boundaries. One source-only January 13 motorbike-taxi lead remains pending_evidence because the year is unstated and the direct page returned forbidden; it is not counted as a verified January 2021 event. Two adjacent/out-of-period leads are excluded with reasons. Search results and opened records do not establish absence or exhaustiveness. LexisNexis, full source-universe coverage, independent Kinyarwanda review, and official baseline gates remain unresolved.
